["59804", "CHEK8TIMI JUSQU’OÙ L’EAU EST PROFONDE…UNE HISTOIRE QUI SE FAÇONNE", "Vivez une expérience immersive au cœur de l’histoire du poste de traite de Chicoutimi grâce à cette exposition interactive historique et archéologique. L’histoire de la région étant intimement liée à sa géographie, l’objectif principal de l’exposition est de raconter cette histoire par la lunette du site historique du POSTE DE TRAITE DE CHICOUTIMI, à la fois à l’intérieur du musée dans une salle d’exposition et à l’extérieur directement sur le site de l’ancien poste de traite de Chicoutimi.

Grâce à 2 mini tablettes, il est maintenant possible de visionner le reportage de La Fabrique Culturelle sur le POSTE DE TRAITE DE CHICOUTIMI réalisé en août 2018 avec l’archéologue de l’UQAC Érik Langevin. Cet ajout permettra aux visiteurs de faire plus facilement le lien entre l’exposition CHEK8TIMI et le POSTE DE TRAITE DE CHICOUTIMI et de mieux comprendre l’importance de ce site patrimonial d’importance.
Berceau de l’occupation du territoire, Le Poste de traite de Chicoutimi

Il côtoie les artistes améri-cains qui sont parmi les premiers étrangers à découvrir la Bretagne, fondant à Pont-Aven et à Concarneau de véritables colonies artistiques. La fileuse, peinte par le jeune Paul Peel dans son atelier parisien, sera une des premières œuvres canadiennes à entrer dans la collection de l'Art Association of Montreal. Formé à la peinture académique, Peel en applique les principes : il organise la composition autour d'un personnage central et traite les modelés avec précision. Décor et accessoires appuient ici une volonté manifeste de pittoresque. La fileuse, probablement un modèle professionnel, est vêtue d'un costume breton et porte la petite coiffe typique de la région de Rosporden, dans le sud du Finistère. Elle tient à la main une quenouille ; derrière elle, un enfant dort dans un lit clos. ["A", "Catégorie", "Habiletés", "Aptitudes innées et développées facilitant l’acquisition de connaissances et de compétences requises pour effectuer le travail attendu."]
["A.01", "Sous-catégorie", "Habiletés cognitives", "Habiletés ayant une incidence sur l’acquisition et l’application de connaissances dans l’exécution de diverses activités mentales au travail."]
["A.01.a", "Groupe de similitude", "Habiletés à générer des idées et à raisonner", ""]

["A.01.a.01", "Descripteur", "Ordonner de l’information", "L’habileté à disposer des éléments ou des actions dans un certain ordre ou un modèle, conformément à une règle spécifique ou à un ensemble de règles comme les séquences de chiffres, de lettres, de mots, d’images et d’opérations mathématiques."]
["A.01.a.02", "Descripteur", "Souplesse dans la catégorisation", "L’habileté à générer ou à utiliser un ensemble de règles pour combiner ou regrouper des choses de différentes façons."]
["A.01.a.03", "Descripteur", "Raisonnement déductif", "L’habileté à appliquer des règles générales pour formuler des réponses logiques à des problèmes spécifiques."]

["A.01.a.04", "Descripteur", "Raisonnement inductif", "L’habileté à combiner des éléments d’information pour former des règles générales ou des conclusions, ce qui comprend de trouver une relation entre des événements apparemment sans liens."]
["A.01.a.05", "Descripteur", "Facilité à concevoir des idées", "L’habileté à imaginer plusieurs idées sur un même sujet."]

["A.01.a.06", "Descripteur", "Détection de problèmes", "L’habileté à identifier un problème existant ou potentiel. Il ne s'agit pas de résoudre le problème, mais seulement d’en reconnaître la présence."]
["A.01.b.01", "Descripteur", "Habileté numériques", "L’habileté à effectuer des opérations arithmétiques telles que des additions, des soustractions, des multiplications et des divisions."]
["A.01.b.02", "Descripteur", "Raisonnement mathématique", "L’habileté à choisir les bonnes méthodes ou formules mathématiques pour résoudre un problème."]
["A.01.c.01", "Descripteur", "Mémorisation", "L’habileté à se souvenir d’informations tels que des mots, des chiffres, des images ou des procédures."]

["A.01.c.02", "Descripteur", "Tâches multiples", "L’habileté à alterner entre deux ou plusieurs activités ou sources d’information comme des conversations, des sons, le toucher ou d’autres stimuli, pendant la même période."]

["A.01.c.03", "Descripteur", "Identification de motifs", "L'habileté à identifier, à repérer ou à détecter un motif connu, tel qu'une figure, un objet, un mot ou un son, qui est dissimulé parmi d'autres informations ou matériaux."]
["A.01.c.04", "Descripteur", "Vitesse d’organisation de motifs", "L’habileté à combiner et à organiser rapidement de l’information pour obtenir des structures ou modèles significatifs."]

["A.01.c.05", "Descripteur", "Vitesse de perception", "L’habileté à comparer avec rapidité et précision les similitudes et les différences entre des ensembles de lettres, de chiffres, d’objets, d’images ou de modèles. Les éléments à comparer peuvent être présentés en même temps, l'un après l'autre ou à partir d'un objet mémorisé."]

["2018", "Q2018-01", "Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services (MCSCS)", "1. Implementation of EMR (Electronic Medical Records) by the Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services and their facilities.", "The Ministry of Community Safety and Correctional Services (MCSCS) is working with the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care (MOHLTC) to review requirements for the acquisition of an enterprise-wide electronic health record (EHR) solution for all correctional facilities to:
a. Improve ability to document and monitor client health status over time; 
b. Facilitate continuity of care through improved communications; Inform clinical decisions, such as how to best utilize staff and services towards improving health care outcomes; and
c. Provide data to inform planning and training needs for continuous improvement.

The current focus of MCSCS is to build upon the work that has been done previously to evaluate options for automation solutions that do not preclude any future changes to the current service delivery model. An enterprise-wide, fully integrated EHR remains a strategic priority for the ministry.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-01", "MCSCS", "2. Quinte Detention Centre to follow the Ministry of Community Safety and Correction Services standards and guidelines with specific attention to Methadone Maintenance Treatment policy.", "The MCSCS Methadone Maintenance Treatment (MMT) Policy and Procedure align with the College of Physician and Surgeons on Ontario Guidelines for MMT. The MCSCS recently revised its policy and procedure to clarify and broaden initiation of treatment to address the elevated risk of opioid overdose prevalent in the corrections population. This aligns with the current MOHLTC Provincial Opioid Strategy. The policy was released on April 17, 2018. Education was provided to health care staff via Adobe connects and a letter outlining the policy revisions was sent to physicians at the time of release.

Since this inquest, a new physician has been contracted at the Quinte DC for the MMT program. The Health Care Manager has provided the physician with the MCSCS MMT policy and procedure and reviewed the expectations. Further, the Health Care Manager has developed an action plan to ensure required processes are in place and followed. All Quinte DC nursing staff were provided the revised management of opioid withdrawal policy. Additional education sessions were done on May 2, 8 and 10, 2018 to ensure all nursing staff are trained and familiar with the policy revisions and expectations.

A nursing staff meeting took place on May 16, 2018 to ensure the nurses received the feedback from the physician regarding process, and review the plan with regard to the new MMT policy, and to ensure that nursing staff are aware of the changes and the immediate implementation. The Health Care Manager will audit 10 health care records weekly to ensure compliance with the management of opioid withdrawal policy. This process was initiated on May 14, 2018 and continues on a weekly basis.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-01", "MCSCS", "3. More thorough assessment of incoming inmates during early incarceration period to ensure proper medical evaluation (i.e., COWS, urine panel test).", "The MCSCS has completed a review and revised the Management of Opioid Withdrawal policy and procedure. As part of the review, specific requirements for ongoing monitoring was added. The revised policy was released on April 17, 2018 and health care staff education was provided via webinar on April 17, 2018 and repeated on April 24, 2018. The ministry continues to engage and consult with community substance use experts to discuss strategies to safely and effectively manage opioid withdrawal.

The revised management of opioid withdrawal policy was also provided to the physician(s). The changes in requirements were reinforced during a nursing staff meeting on May 16, 2018. A urine drug panel testing is done before administering the first dose of methadone, and then random tests are done monthly. Where urinalysis is positive for drug or when an individual has symptoms of possible drug toxicity, the physician is consulted.

All new admissions are assessed by the primary care physician. When a physician is not on-site, the nurses will call the physician regarding an inmate's health condition, including concerns about substance use. The correctional staff notify the nurses of all new admissions and any medical concerns presented by the inmate. Based on the notification, the nurse conducts a first assessment, which consists of triaging the inmate's immediate health concerns and current medications followed by a more detailed evaluation, within 24 hours of admission. During medication rounds, the nurse assesses an inmate when a health care concern is identified. Additionally, the correctional officers notify the unit nurses if an inmate has a health concern, and the nurse assesses the inmate as soon as practicable.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-01", "MCSCS", "4. We support the delivery of the MMT/medical services at Quinte Detention Centre, which should be provided in a timely manner.", "The Quinte DC supports the delivery of MMT/medical services in a timely manner. The primary care physician has on-site clinics three days a week, and the nurses triage and schedule the clients for these clinics. When the physician is not on-site, there is a physician on-call, and the nurses contact them regarding new admissions and if there are concerns regarding the health status of individuals. The MMT physician has an on-site clinic every two weeks, and the nurses call the physician regarding new admissions or other methadone related concerns. The Quinte DC submitted a business case on May 30, 2018 for additional methadone services to increase the MMT physician clinic to once a week to improve access to MMT services.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-01", "Centre of Forensic Sciences (CFS)", "5. Centre of Forensic Sciences should have the ability to detect the presence/absence of all medication prescribed in a correctional facility.", "The Centre of Forensic Sciences (CFS) is able to detect and or quantitate a vast array of the most frequently encountered and forensically relevant over-the counter prescription, and recreational/illicit drugs. New drugs (both licit and illicit) are continually being developed and used for new purposes and it is not practical for the CFS to develop quantitation methods and purchase applicable standard reference samples for all drugs.

To prioritize the development of methods for new drugs that are significant in criminal and death investigations, CFS consults with agencies including Health Canada laboratories, Canadian Border Service Agency laboratories, the Office of the Chief Coroner of Ontario, Ontario Forensic Pathology Services and other forensic toxicology laboratories.

Although CFS has the ability to detect Paliperidone using a screening method, it does not have a method to confirm the concentration of the drug in post mortem samples. Although this drug was first introduced into the US in 2007, there have been few reports of any toxic effects reported with its use, and a consequent lack of data as to post-mortem blood concentrations associated with toxic and/or fatal concentrations. Thus, development of a method for quantitation of this drug at toxic and/or potentially fatal concentrations has not been possible or probative.

Reports issued by CFS Toxicology include the drug(s) detected, the methods used for the analysis and a link to a list of all of the drugs that were tested for. This allows the pathologist and/or coroner to have the sample tested by another laboratory if CFS does not have a method for a specific drug of interest.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "1. Ensure correctional staff are trained regularly on the use of Naloxone including signs and symptoms of opioid overdose.", "Naloxone, both injectable and nasal, is currently available to Health Care staff in all correctional facilities. All institutions currently have nasal Naloxone kits available for use by trained sergeants in the event that health care staff are not available. The ministry is nearing completion of the training of correctional officers in the use of Intranasal Naloxone Spray as they will have access to the spray within correctional facilities ensuring its accessibility for the emergency treatment of suspected opioid overdose.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "2. Ensure regular training of health care staff on withdrawal and toxicity of commonly abused drugs including the use of the CIWA and COWS scales.", "As of March 2017, the use of the Clinical Institute Withdrawal Assessment for Alcohol (CIWA-Ar) and the Clinical Opioid Withdrawal Scale (COWS) were included in the new nurses orientation and physician welcome packages (implemented in March 2017). The recommended clinical protocols for management of alcohol withdrawal and management of opioid withdrawal have been incorporated into the ministry's formulary. Corporate Health Care hosts regular training webinars to ensure that health care staff are familiar with the management of alcohol and opioid withdrawal policies and procedures, toxicity of commonly abused drugs, and the use of the CIWA-Ar and COWs scales. During the webinar, expectations for documentation were reinforced.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "3. Use the facts of Mr. Sutton’s and Mr. Stevens’ deaths to develop case studies to train health care staff. This training should be designed, developed and delivered in collaboration with front line staff.", "Corporate Health Care, in collaboration with TSDC staff will develop case studies (including the facts of Mr. Sutton's and Mr. Stevens' deaths) and conduct webinars for health care staff with regard to the issues identified at this inquest.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "4. Ensure regular training of health care staff on documentation standards set by the College of Nurses and Ministry expectations. This should include standards related to charting by exception.", "The College of Nurses of Ontario (CNO) is the governing body for all nurses employed in Ontario. The CNO publishes practice standards and guidelines for all nurses and nurses are expected to review and abide by these standards and guidelines in their practice setting. These practice standards include a standard on documentation and professional standards, as well as learning modules. Corporate Health Care does provide and arrange training on documentation, and the Health Care Manager, Toronto South Detention Centre (TSDC) has made arrangements for all nursing staff to review the CNO documentation standards. The Health Care Manager, TSDC, regularly reviews the health care services policies and procedures, which include documentation and communication procedures, with the health care team members.\n\nIt is part of the nursing professional obligations to pursue education outside the workplace. The MCSCS encourages employees to identify training needs and assistance required to meet these goals. TSDC nurses are encouraged to attend corporate health care in service training and case reviews. Regular educational sessions via the Ontario Telemedicine Network are also available to all nurses. They are presented by various disciplines and hospitals to promote current standards of practice.", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "6. Within twelve months from the date of this verdict, establish a working group of experts and senior Ministry staff to coordinate a strategic plan for reducing the risks from illicit drug use in custody, including and not limited to:
i) identifying harm reduction strategies that will be employed;
ii) tracking of fatal and non-fatal drug overdoses in custody; and
iii) the detection and screening methods to be employed such as x-rays and other new techniques to identify drugs concealed within the person.", "The MCSCS will continue to work with the Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care (MOHLTC) who are the lead for the provincial Opioid Strategy and other experts to develop strategies to reduce the risks from illicit drug use while clients are in custody. 

To date, MOHLTC and MCSCS have worked together to develop strategies to prevent opioid overdose:
- On January 30, 2017, an initial information session regarding the dangers of Opioid Overdose Risk and Prevention Strategies was conducted with every inmate in custody in an Ontario correctional institution. Health teaching is now conducted upon admission by nurses during the admission health assessment.
- All individuals admitted to an Ontario correctional institution have access to the Inmate Information Guide. Included in this guide is a section entitled "Tolerance to drugs and risk for overdose"""". This section provides inmates with information about the risks of Opioid and other drug use.""]

["As part of the MOHLTC province-wide strategy to address Opioid overdose", " the MCSCS has implemented a 'Take Home Naloxone' (THN) program in all facilities. The program", " which provides THN kits at discharge", " and includes health teaching on overdose risk", " signs of overdose and use of Naloxone", " is available to all inmates who are identified or identify as at-risk for opioid overdose and want to have a THN kit at discharge. Additionally", " visual aids (such as signage", " brochures and/or posters) and ad-hoc information sessions are used in institutions to enhance awareness of overdose risk. The MCSCS continues to work closely with MOHLTC on strategies to mitigate risk. The ministry tracks fatal and non-fatal drug overdoses on the inmate's medical file as well as any treatment provided."]

["In August 2015", " the ministry installed an x-ray body scanner at the TSDC. In May 2016 the ministry committed to installing x-ray scanners in every institution and as of August 2018", " all institutions except one have operational body scanners. The effective use of the technology can have a dramatic impact on the reduction of the amount of contraband that enters an institution.\"\"", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

["2018", "Q2018-02", "MCSCS", "8. Ensure correctional staff are trained on the requirement to communicate with other staff between shifts. This training should include the use of communication tools such as magnet indicators on segregation doors.", "Communication amongst all correctional staff, including health care is paramount. Staff are routinely reminded to review the Standing Orders to ensure they are aware of their obligations when they receive/have pertinent information on the well-being of an inmate. It is ministry policy that all employees responsible for the care of inmates alert the appropriate officials and take the appropriate steps if they believe that an inmate's well-being may be at risk (to themselves or to others). Observations are captured through the completion of required documentation (i.e., log book entries, occurrence reports, etc.) per ministry policy and procedures.

It is the responsibility of the officer being relieved from duty to share all pertinent information that occurred during the course of their shift. It is also the responsibility of the officer assuming duties to read the log book entries, observation sheets, etc. The facility has issued a memorandum to all staff to remind them of their responsibilities in this regard on April 4, 2017. A further memorandum was issued to managers regarding internal communications and log books on May 16, 2018.

Training on communication is imbedded into the COTA program. Recruits receive overarching material in their Self-Directed Learning package titled "Special Management Inmates"""". Specific training regarding the use of magnetic indicators on segregation doors is covered in the classroom instruction for the Special Management Inmates lesson."""", "", "", "", "", "", ""]

Areas, or segments of the coastline, where the first two variables (e.g., shoreline classification and REI) co-occurred were defined as ‘moderately suitable’ habitat, those where the first three variables (e.g., shoreline classification, REI, and bathymetry) co occurred were defined as ‘suitable’ habitat, and those where all four variables (e.g., shoreline classification, REI, bathymetry, and linear water flow features) co-occurred were defined as ‘highly suitable’ habitat.", "Trois classes qualitatives de favorabilité de l'habitat ont été définies en fonction du nombre de variables prédictives convergentes à chaque étape de l'analyse. Les zones ou segments de littoral où les deux premières variables (e.g., classification du littoral et IER) étaient présentes simultanément ont été définies comme un habitat « modérément favorable », celles où les trois premières variables (e.g., classification du littoral, IER et bathymétrie) étaient présentes simultanément ont été définies comme un habitat « favorable », et celles où les quatre variables (e.g., classification du littoral, IER, bathymétrie et courants d'eau linéaires) étaient présentes simultanément ont été définies comme un habitat « très favorable ». ["﻿Sexe à la naissance de la personne - Définition", "« Sexe à la naissance » réfère au sexe assigné à la naissance. Le sexe à la naissance d'une personne est habituellement assigné en fonction de son système reproducteur et d'autres caractéristiques physiques.

Le sexe à la naissance peut également être compris comme étant le sexe enregistré à la naissance (p. ex. ce qui est enregistré sur le certificat de naissance).

« Personne » réfère à l'individu et il s'agit de l'unité d'analyse utilisée pour la plupart des programmes de la statistique sociale.", "", ""]

["Sexe à la naissance de la personne - Usage", "Bien qu'ils renvoient à deux concepts différents, le sexe à la naissance et le genre sont étroitement liés. Le sexe à la naissance est principalement considéré sous l'angle physique et biologique, comme les chromosomes, les organes génitaux et les hormones, alors que le genre est un concept multidimensionnel qui est influencé par plusieurs autres facteurs, dont les normes culturelles et comportementales et l'identité personnelle.

Il convient de faire preuve de prudence lorsqu'on compare les chiffres de la variable « sexe à la naissance de la personne » avec ceux de la variable « genre de la personne ». Chez la plupart des gens, le sexe à la naissance correspond à leur genre. Par contre, chez certaines personnes, le sexe à la naissance peut être différent de leur genre. Par exemple, le groupe de personnes de sexe féminin dans une population donnée ne correspond pas nécessairement au groupe de personnes de genre féminin, bien que ces deux groupes soient généralement très semblables étant donné la taille relativement petite des populations transgenre et non binaire.

La variable « genre de la personne » devrait être utilisée par défaut dans la plupart des programmes de la statistique sociale à Statistique Canada, conformément aux « Orientations stratégiques pour moderniser les pratiques du gouvernement du Canada en matière d'information sur le sexe et le genre » du Secrétariat du Conseil du Trésor du Canada (2018).

La variable « sexe à la naissance de la personne » peut être utilisée lorsque des renseignements sur le sexe à la naissance sont nécessaires, par exemple dans le calcul de certains indicateurs démographiques ou de santé. Elle peut être utilisée en plus de la variable « genre de la personne » pour estimer la population transgenre. Ces deux variables peuvent également être utilisées, lorsqu'elles sont combinées à la variable « orientation sexuelle de la personne », pour estimer les populations de la diversité de genre et sexuelle, qui sont souvent représentées par l'acronyme LGBTQ2+ (lesbienne, gaie, bisexuelle, transgenre, queer, bispirituelle ou une autre identité de la diversité de genre ou sexuelle).

L'information portant sur le sexe à la naissance peut reposer sur des données autodéclarées ou sur des réponses fournies par personne interposée selon le programme statistique.

Certaines personnes peuvent être réticentes à fournir une réponse à la question sur le sexe à la naissance ou fournir une réponse différente selon le contexte dans lequel elle est posée ou en fonction de l'ordre des questions (p. ex. si la question sur le sexe à la naissance précède ou non celle sur le genre). Le degré de confidentialité, de sécurité et de pertinence perçue au moment de la collecte de ces renseignements peut influencer la façon dont une personne répond à cette question.", "", ""]

["Sexe à la naissance de la personne - Conformité aux normes pertinentes reconnues à l'échelle internationale", "Cette norme contient des renseignements plus détaillés et plus précis que les recommandations des Nations Unies en matière de recensements que l'on trouve dans les « Principes et recommandations concernant les recensements de la population et des logements, troisième révision » (2017). Le document des Nations Unies ne précise pas les catégories dans la définition du sexe et ne précise pas non plus si le sexe fait référence au sexe à la naissance.

Dans les « Recommandations de la Conférence des statisticiens européens pour les recensements de la population et des habitations de 2020 » (2015), il est reconnu que certains pays ont commencé à utiliser d'autres catégories de sexe en plus de « masculin » et « féminin ». L'option d'une troisième catégorie pour le sexe est offerte dans la variante de la classification du sexe dans la norme actuelle. La Conférence des statisticiens européens indique que des questions liées à la collecte de données et à la divulgation par recoupements doivent être prises en compte lorsque l'on utilise une classification comportant une troisième catégorie pour le sexe :

On sait que l'enregistrement ou le codage de larges catégories de réponses (telles que « masculin » ou « féminin ») est soumis à une petite erreur proportionnelle, et que ces catégories peuvent néanmoins être plus importantes que le nombre de réponses correctement enregistrées pour une catégorie rare (telle que « troisième » sexe). Même au sein d'un sous-groupe présentant un intérêt particulier, le type de réponse peut être sensiblement affecté par la formulation de la question. Il est par conséquent vivement recommandé aux pays d'entreprendre un programme d'essais rigoureux avant de tenter de recueillir ce type d'informations lors du recensement. En outre, il convient de noter que le fait d'inclure ces catégories dans les résultats pose un risque pour la communication des statistiques, dans la mesure où ces chiffres seront probablement très faibles, notamment lorsqu'ils sont confrontés avec d'autres variables du recensement.

La norme ISO/IEC 5218:2004, « Technologies de l'information - Codes de représentation des sexes humains », spécifie une méthode de représentation uniforme des sexes humains pour l'échange d'information. Elle reconnaît deux sexes (masculin et féminin), conformément à la « Classification du sexe à la naissance » présentée dans la norme actuelle. Bien que la norme ISO/CEI fournisse des codes numériques, elle précise que ces codes ne se substituent pas aux normes nationales pour les codes dérivés des noms de sexes.

Cette norme correspond à la définition présentée dans le glossaire des termes et des outils sur le genre, l'équité et les droits de la personne de l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé et fait référence au sexe assigné en fonction des caractéristiques physiques. Bien que l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé indique que de telles caractéristiques servent à définir « masculin » et « féminin », cette norme fournit également une variante de la classification comptant trois catégories (« sexe masculin », « sexe féminin » et « intersexe »).

Cette norme présente également des similitudes avec les définitions du sexe à la naissance publiées par Statistics New Zealand dans « Statistical standard for gender, sex, and variations of sex characteristics » (2021) [en anglais seulement] et par l'Australian Bureau of Statistics dans « Standard for Sex, Gender, Variations of Sex Characteristics and Sexual Orientation Variables » (2021) [en anglais seulement].

Statistics New Zealand définit le sexe à la naissance comme étant [Traduction] « le sexe enregistré à la naissance (p. ex. ce qui est enregistré sur le certificat de naissance). » L'Australian Bureau of Statistics le définit comme étant [Traduction] « le sexe enregistré à la naissance qui fait référence aux caractéristiques sexuelles observées à la naissance ou pendant la petite enfance. » À l'instar de la norme actuelle, ces organismes fournissent une variante de la classification du sexe qui comprend une troisième catégorie appelée « un autre terme » en Nouvelle-Zélande, et « un autre terme » et « sexe non binaire » en Australie.", "", ""]

["1", "Broad occupational category", "0", "Management occupations", "This category includes legislators, senior management occupations and middle management occupations. Senior managers are described in several broad categories. Middle managers are described in more detailed categories that span the entire labour market."]
["2", "Major group", "00", "Senior management occupations", "This major group comprises senior management occupations. It includes legislators and senior managers in the public and private sectors."]

["3", "Minor group", "001", "Legislators and senior management", "This minor group includes legislators and senior management occupations in the public and private sectors. They are employed by federal, provincial, territorial and local government legislative bodies, executive councils, band councils and school boards; municipal and regional governments and provincial, territorial and federal departments, boards, agencies and commissions; and throughout the private sector."]

["4", "Unit group", "0011", "Legislators", "Legislators participate in the activities of a federal, provincial, territorial or local government legislative body or executive council, band council or school board as elected or appointed members."]

["4", "Unit group", "0012", "Senior government managers and officials", "Senior government managers and officials plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through middle managers, the major activities of municipal or regional governments or of provincial, territorial or federal departments, boards, agencies or commissions. They establish the direction to be taken by these organizations in accordance with legislation and policies made by elected representatives or legislative bodies."]

["4", "Unit group", "0013", "Senior managers - financial, communications and other business services", "Senior managers in this unit group are usually appointed by a board of directors, to which they report. They work either alone or in conjunction with the board of directors to develop and establish objectives for the company, and to develop or approve policies and programs. They plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through middle managers, the operations of their organization in relation to established objectives. They work in establishments throughout the telecommunications, finance, insurance, real estate, and data processing, hosting and related services industries as well as other business service industries or they may own and operate their own business."]

["4", "Unit group", "0014", "Senior managers - health, education, social and community services and membership organizations", "Senior managers in this unit group plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through middle managers, membership and other organizations or institutions that deliver health, education, social or community services. They formulate policies which establish the direction to be taken by these organizations, either alone or in conjunction with a board of directors. They are employed in health care organizations, educational services, social and community services and membership organizations or they may own and operate their own business."]

["4", "Unit group", "0015", "Senior managers - trade, broadcasting and other services, n.e.c.", "Senior managers in this unit group plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through middle managers, trade, broadcasting and other service companies not elsewhere classified. They formulate policies which establish the direction to be taken by these companies, either alone or in conjunction with a board of directors. They work in establishments in broadcasting and related media services, wholesale trade, retail trade, accommodation and food service, and other services not elsewhere classified or they may own and operate their own business."]

["4", "Unit group", "0016", "Senior managers - construction, transportation, production and utilities", "Senior managers in this unit group plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate, through middle managers, the overall operations of goods production, utility, transportation and construction companies. They formulate policies which establish the direction to be taken by these companies, either alone or in conjunction with other members of a board of directors. They work in establishments throughout the following industries: fishing, forestry, logging and agriculture; mining, oil and gas extraction; construction; transportation and warehousing; printing; manufacturing; and utilities or they may own and operate their own business."]

["2", "Major group", "01-05", "Specialized middle management occupations", "This major group comprises specialized middle management occupations. It includes administrative services managers and managers in financial and business services, communication (except broadcasting), engineering, architecture, science and information systems, health care, public administration, education, social and community services, public protection services, art, culture, recreation, and sport."]

["3", "Minor group", "011", "Administrative services managers", "This minor group includes financial managers, human resources managers, purchasing managers and other administrative service managers. They are employed throughout the public and private sectors."]

["4", "Unit group", "0111", "Financial managers", "Financial managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the operation of financial and accounting departments. They develop and implement the financial policies and systems of establishments. Financial managers establish performance standards and prepare various financial reports for senior management. They are employed in financial and accounting departments in companies throughout the private sector and in government."]

["4", "Unit group", "0112", "Human resources managers", "Human resources managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the operations of human resources and personnel departments, and develop and implement policies, programs and procedures regarding human resource planning, recruitment, collective bargaining, training and development, occupation classification and pay and benefit administration. They represent management and participate actively on various joint committees to maintain ongoing relations between management and employees. Human resources managers are employed throughout the private and public sectors."]

["4", "Unit group", "0113", "Purchasing managers", "Purchasing managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of a purchasing department and develop and implement the purchasing policies of a business or institution. They are employed throughout the public and private sectors."]

["4", "Unit group", "0114", "Other administrative services managers", "This unit group includes managers who plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate departments responsible for corporate governance and regulatory compliance, records management, security services, admissions and other administrative services not elsewhere classified. Also included in this unit group are managers responsible for departments involved in two or more of the following activities: finance, human resources, purchasing or administrative services. Managers in this unit group are employed throughout the public and private sector."]

["3", "Minor group", "012", "Managers in financial and business services", "This minor group includes insurance, real estate and financial brokerage managers; banking, credit and investment managers; advertising, marketing, and public relations managers; and other business services managers. They are employed by insurance companies, real estate firms, stockbrokers, investment dealers, mortgage brokers and security and commodity exchanges; banks, trust companies and credit unions; credit departments in department stores and other industrial and commercial organizations; credit card, consumer loan, mutual fund, mortgage and other loan, financing and investment companies; government departments; advertising, marketing and public relations firms and consulting businesses; and other establishments that provide services to business."]

["4", "Unit group", "0121", "Insurance, real estate and financial brokerage managers", "Insurance, real estate and financial brokerage managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of departments or establishments that provide insurance, mortgage, real estate and investment services. They are generally responsible for business development and must ensure that their group reaches performance levels related to established objectives. They are employed by insurance companies, real estate firms, stockbrokers, investment dealers, mortgage brokers and security and commodity exchanges."]

["4", "Unit group", "0122", "Banking, credit and other investment managers", "Banking, credit and other investment managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of financial establishments or operational departments within such establishments, or credit departments in industrial and commercial establishments. They oversee business development and manage overall performance in accordance with established strategic directions and policies. Banking managers are employed by banks, trust companies and credit unions. Credit managers are employed by credit departments in department stores, utility companies, car dealerships, insurance companies or other industrial or commercial organizations. Other investment managers are employed by credit card companies, consumer loan companies, mutual fund investment firms, mortgage investment companies or other financial establishments concerned with extending loans and financing and investments."]

["4", "Unit group", "0124", "Advertising, marketing and public relations managers", "Advertising, marketing, public relations and e-business managers plan, organize, direct, control and evaluate the activities of establishments and departments involved in commercial, industrial and e-business advertising, marketing and public relations. They are employed by commercial and industrial establishments, government departments, and advertising, marketing and public relations firms or consulting businesses."]

["﻿Genre de la personne - Définition", "« Genre » réfère à l'identité personnelle et sociale d'un individu en tant qu'homme, femme ou personne non binaire (une personne qui n'est pas exclusivement homme ni femme).

Le genre comprend les concepts suivants :

- l'identité de genre correspond au genre qu'une personne ressent intimement et individuellement;

- l'expression de genre désigne la manière dont une personne présente son genre à travers son langage corporel, des choix esthétiques ou des accessoires (p. ex. vêtements, coiffure et maquillage) qui peuvent avoir été traditionnellement associés à un genre particulier, et ce, sans égard à son identité de genre.

Le genre d'une personne peut différer de son sexe à la naissance et de la mention qui figure sur ses pièces d'identité ou documents juridiques actuels tels que son certificat de naissance, son passeport ou son permis de conduire. Le genre d'une personne peut changer au fil du temps.

Certaines personnes peuvent ne pas s'identifier à un genre en particulier.

« Personne » réfère à l'individu et il s'agit de l'unité d'analyse utilisée pour la plupart des programmes de la statistique sociale.", "", ""]

["Genre de la personne - Usage", "Bien qu'ils renvoient à deux concepts différents, le sexe à la naissance et le genre sont étroitement liés. Le sexe à la naissance est principalement considéré sous l'angle physique et biologique, comme les chromosomes, les organes génitaux et les hormones, alors que le genre est un concept multidimensionnel qui est influencé par plusieurs autres facteurs, dont les normes culturelles et comportementales et l'identité personnelle.

Il convient de faire preuve de prudence lorsqu'on compare les chiffres de la variable « sexe à la naissance de la personne » avec ceux de la variable « genre de la personne ». Chez la plupart des gens, le sexe à la naissance correspond à leur genre. Par contre, chez certaines personnes, le sexe à la naissance peut être différent de leur genre. Par exemple, le groupe de personnes de sexe féminin dans une population donnée ne correspond pas nécessairement au groupe de personnes de genre féminin, bien que ces deux groupes soient généralement très semblables étant donné la taille relativement petite des populations transgenre et non binaire.

Le concept de genre est également différent de celui de l'orientation sexuelle, un terme générique qui comprend l'identité sexuelle, l'attirance sexuelle et le comportement sexuel d'une personne.

Le concept de genre varie selon les cultures, les régions et les pays. Il est en constante évolution puisqu'il est fortement influencé par les transformations sociales.

La variable « genre de la personne » devrait être utilisée par défaut dans la plupart des programmes de la statistique sociale à Statistique Canada, conformément aux « Orientations stratégiques pour moderniser les pratiques du gouvernement du Canada en matière d'information sur le sexe et le genre » du Secrétariat du Conseil du Trésor du Canada (2018).

La variable « sexe à la naissance de la personne » peut être utilisée lorsque des renseignements sur le sexe à la naissance sont nécessaires, par exemple dans le calcul de certains indicateurs démographiques ou de santé. Elle peut être utilisée, en plus de la variable « genre de la personne », pour estimer la population transgenre. Ces deux variables peuvent également être utilisées, lorsqu'elles sont combinées à la variable « orientation sexuelle de la personne », pour estimer les populations de la diversité de genre et sexuelle, qui sont souvent représentées par l'acronyme LGBTQ2+ (lesbienne, gaie, bisexuelle, transgenre, queer, bispirituelle ou une autre identité de la diversité de genre ou sexuelle).

Dans les programmes statistiques, le genre peut être déclaré en fonction de l'identité ou de l'expression de genre d'une personne, ainsi qu'en fonction de la façon dont une personne est perçue par les autres, selon que l'information sur le genre repose sur des données autodéclarées ou sur des réponses par personne interposée. L'information portant sur le sexe à la naissance peut également reposer sur des données autodéclarées ou sur des réponses fournies par personne interposée selon le programme statistique.

Certaines personnes peuvent être réticentes à fournir une réponse à la question sur le genre ou fournir une réponse différente selon le contexte dans lequel elle est posée ou en fonction de l'ordre des questions (p. ex. si la question sur le sexe à la naissance précède ou non celle sur le genre). Le degré de confidentialité, de sécurité et de pertinence perçue au moment de la collecte de ces renseignements peut influencer la façon dont une personne répond à cette question.

La question sur le genre peut être posée aux personnes de tous âges, y compris les enfants âgés de 14 ans et moins, selon la population observée.", "", ""]

["Genre de la personne - Conformité aux normes pertinentes reconnues à l'échelle internationale", "Cette norme présente des similitudes avec la définition du genre publiée par le Williams Institute de la faculté de droit de l'Université de Californie à Los Angeles dans le rapport intitulé « Best Practices for Asking Questions to Identify Transgender and Other Gender Minority Respondents on Population-Based Surveys » (2014) [en anglais seulement]. Dans le cadre du rapport, le genre est défini comme [Traduction] « une construction multidimensionnelle comportant des dimensions psychologiques, sociales et comportementales qui comprennent l'identité de genre et l'expression de genre ».

Les « Principes de Jogjakarta sur l'application de la législation internationale des droits humains en matière d'orientation sexuelle et d'identité de genre » (2017), rédigés par la Commission internationale de juristes et soutenus par le Haut-Commissariat des Nations Unies aux droits de l'homme, présentent une définition de l'identité de genre qui comprend l'expression de genre :

L'identité de genre est comprise comme faisant référence à l'expérience intime et personnelle de son genre profondément vécue par chacun, qu'elle corresponde ou non au sexe assigné à la naissance, y compris la conscience personnelle du corps (qui peut impliquer, si consentie librement, une modification de l'apparence ou des fonctions corporelles par des moyens médicaux, chirurgicaux ou autres) et d'autres expressions du genre, y compris l'habillement, le discours et les manières de se conduire.

Cette norme présente également des similitudes avec les définitions du genre publiées par Statistics New Zealand dans « Statistical standard for gender, sex, and variations of sex characteristics » (2021) [en anglais seulement] et par l'Australian Bureau of Statistics dans « Standard for Sex, Gender, Variations of Sex Characteristics and Sexual Orientation Variables » (2021) [en anglais seulement].

Statistics New Zealand définit le genre comme étant [Traduction] « l'identité personnelle et sociale d'une personne en tant qu'homme, femme, personne d'un autre genre ou d'un genre qui peut être considéré comme non binaire ». L'Australian Bureau of Statistics le définit comme étant [Traduction] « un concept social et culturel. Il s'agit des différences sociales et culturelles au niveau de l'identité, de l'expression et de l'expérience en tant qu'homme, femme ou personne non binaire ».

Cette norme diffère légèrement des définitions plus classiques sur le genre qui sont utilisées dans le cadre des comparaisons statistiques des caractéristiques socioéconomiques des femmes et des hommes. Certains organismes internationaux, tels que le Conseil de l'Europe et l'Organisation mondiale de la Santé, définissent le genre comme étant les caractéristiques socialement établies des femmes et des hommes, comme les normes, les rôles et les comportements attendus.", "", ""]

["Genre de la personne - Rapport avec la version antérieure", "Cette norme générale remplace la norme recommandée « Genre de la personne ». La définition de genre a été modifiée. Certains noms de catégories et définitions des classifications ont été mis à jour. Le nom de la « Classification de cisgenre, transgenre et non binaire » a été modifié depuis la norme précédente.", "", ""]

["Classification du genre - Usage", "Les catégories de cette classification sont dérivées à partir de la question standardisée sur le genre.

Les définitions de cette classification font référence aux termes « masculin » et « féminin » pour décrire le genre puisqu'ils sont utilisés dans la question standardisée sur le genre. Toutefois, les noms des catégories emploient plutôt les termes « homme » et « femme » pour faire référence au « genre masculin » et au « genre féminin ».

Selon le programme statistique, la population observée peut comprendre des enfants. Dans de tels cas, l'usage des termes « garçon » et « fille » est préférable à celui des termes « homme » et « femme » lorsqu'il est question d'enfants.
L'information sur le genre peut reposer sur des données autodéclarées ou sur des réponses fournies par personne interposée en fonction du programme statistique. C'est pourquoi l'expression « genre déclaré » est employée dans ces définitions.

Le terme « non binaire » est un terme générique de plus en plus utilisé pour désigner les personnes qui considèrent que leur genre ne se limite pas exclusivement au genre féminin ou masculin, ni au concept de femme ou d'homme, tel qu'il est mentionné dans le document « Examen approfondi de la mesure de l'identité de genre » (2019) rédigé par Statistique Canada et l'Office for National Statistics du Royaume-Uni. Toutefois, les personnes qui, selon cette classification, font partie de la catégorie « personne non binaire » n'utilisent pas forcément ce terme pour décrire leur identité de genre.

En anglais, l'expression « another gender », traduite par « un autre genre » en français, peut être employée. Cependant, il est préférable d'employer le terme générique « non binaire » en français. L'expression « un autre genre » peut porter à confusion puisque le mot « genre » revêt plusieurs sens en français.

Les genres binaires comprennent à la fois les hommes et les femmes cisgenres (cis) et transgenres (trans) dont le genre déclaré est exclusivement masculin ou féminin.

Compte tenu de la petite taille de la population non binaire, lorsque les données de la troisième catégorie ne peuvent être publiées afin de protéger la confidentialité des réponses fournies par la population canadienne, les personnes dans cette catégorie sont alors réparties entre les deux premières catégories.", "", ""]
["Niveau 1", "1", "Homme ", "Cette catégorie comprend les personnes dont le genre déclaré est masculin. Elle comprend les hommes cisgenres (cis) et les hommes transgenres (trans). "]
["Niveau 1", "2", "Femme ", "Cette catégorie comprend les personnes dont le genre déclaré est féminin. Elle comprend les femmes cisgenres (cis) et les femmes transgenres (trans)."]

["Niveau 1", "3", "Personne non binaire ", "Cette catégorie comprend les personnes dont le genre déclaré n’est pas exclusivement masculin ni féminin.

Elle comprend les personnes dont le genre déclaré est, par exemple, agenre, pangenre, genre queer, genre fluide ou genre non conforme. Elle comprend également les personnes dont le genre déclaré est bispirituel — un terme propre à certains peuples autochtones d’Amérique du Nord.

Elle comprend les personnes dont le genre déclaré est à la fois masculin et féminin, ni l’un ni l’autre ou l’un ou l’autre en plus d’un autre genre. Elle peut également comprendre celles ayant indiqué ou ayant été identifiées par personne interposée comme étant en questionnement ou en processus de décision.
"]

["Classification de cisgenre, transgenre et non binaire - Usage", "Les données pour cette classification sont dérivées en recoupant les catégories de la « Classification du sexe à la naissance » (sexe masculin ou sexe féminin) avec celles de la « Classification du genre » (homme, femme et personne non binaire). Elles sont utilisées exclusivement pour comparer divers groupes de population à des fins statistiques et non pour assigner une identité de genre aux répondants.

Les définitions fournies dans cette classification utilisent les termes « masculin » et « féminin » pour décrire le sexe à la naissance et le genre puisqu'ils sont utilisés dans les questions standardisées sur le sexe à la naissance et le genre. Toutefois, les termes « homme » et « femme » sont employés dans les noms des catégories pour faire référence aux hommes et aux femmes cisgenres (cis) et transgenres (trans).

Selon le programme statistique, la population observée peut comprendre des enfants. Dans de tels cas, l'usage des termes « garçon » et « fille » est préférable à celui des termes « homme » et « femme » lorsqu'il est question d'enfants.

L'information sur le genre et le sexe à la naissance peut reposer sur des données autodéclarées ou sur des réponses fournies par personne interposée en fonction du programme statistique. C'est pourquoi les expressions « genre déclaré » et « sexe à la naissance déclaré » sont utilisées dans ces définitions pour faire référence aux données autodéclarées ou aux réponses fournies par personne interposée.

Le terme « modalité de genre » peut être utilisé pour décrire la relation entre le genre et le sexe à la naissance d'une personne.

Cette classification permet la production et la publication de données sur la population représentant la diversité de genre, qui comprend les hommes et les femmes transgenres (trans) de même que les personnes non binaires.

Dans cette classification, les termes « transgenre » ou « trans » sont utilisés de manière interchangeable pour désigner les personnes dont le genre ne correspond pas à leur sexe à la naissance. Cependant, le terme « trans », considéré comme étant plus inclusif, est de plus en plus utilisé. Il peut parfois être utilisé comme terme générique pour désigner toute personne dont le genre ne correspond pas à son sexe à la naissance, y compris les personnes non binaires bien que ces dernières ne s'identifient pas toutes comme telles. Selon cette classification, les personnes non binaires sont toutefois exclues de la catégorie « personne transgenre » et se retrouvent exclusivement dans la catégorie « personne non binaire ».

De même, les personnes classées comme cisgenres (cis) ou transgenres (trans) selon cette classification n'emploient pas nécessairement ces termes pour décrire leur identité de genre. Les termes « cisgenre » ou « cis » peuvent être employés simplement pour désigner les personnes qui ne sont pas transgenres ou « trans ».", "", ""]

["﻿Sex at birth of person - Definition", "Sex at birth' refers to sex assigned at birth. Sex at birth is typically assigned based on a person's reproductive system and other physical characteristics.

Sex at birth may also be understood as the sex recorded at a person's birth (for example, what was recorded on their birth certificate).

'Person' refers to an individual and is the unit of analysis for most social statistics programs.", "", ""]

["Sex at birth of person - Usage", "Sex at birth and gender refer to two different concepts but are interrelated. While sex at birth is primarily understood in terms of physical and biological features such as chromosomes, genitals and hormones, gender is a multidimensional concept that is influenced by several additional factors, including cultural and behavioural norms, and self-identity.

Caution should be exercised when comparing counts for the sex at birth of person variable with counts for the gender of person variable. For most people, their sex at birth corresponds to their gender. However, some people's gender may be different from their sex at birth. For example, in a given population the group of persons of female sex does not necessarily correspond to the group of persons of female gender, although the two groups are generally very similar given the relatively small size of the transgender and non-binary populations.

The variable 'gender of person' is expected to be used by default in most social statistics programs at Statistics Canada in accordance with the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat's "Policy Direction to Modernize the Government of Canada's Sex and Gender Information Practices"" (2018)."]

["The variable 'sex at birth of person' can be used where information on sex at birth is needed", " for example", " for measuring some demographic and health indicators. It can be used in conjunction with the variable 'gender of person' to estimate the transgender population. These two variables can also be used", " together with the variable 'sexual orientation of person'", " to estimate the gender and sexual diversity populations", " which are often represented by the LGBTQ2+ acronym (lesbian", " gay", " bisexual", " transgender", " queer", " Two-Spirit or another identity of gender or sexual diversity)."]
["Information on sex at birth may be based on self-reported data or reported by proxy depending on the statistical program."]

["Some people may be reluctant to provide an answer to the question on sex at birth or may give a different answer depending on the context in which it is asked or the order of the questions (for example", " whether the question on sex at birth comes before or after the question on gender). The degree of privacy", " safety and perceived relevance for collecting this information may impact how a person responds.\"", "", ""]

["Sex at birth of person - Conformity to relevant internationally recognized standards", "This standard includes more detailed and specific information than the recommendations for censuses contained in the United Nations' \"Principles and Recommendations for Population and Housing Censuses", " Revision 3\"\" (2017). The United Nations document does not state the categories in the definition of sex nor does it specify whether sex refers to sex at birth."]

["The \"\"Conference of European Statisticians Recommendations for the 2020 Censuses of Population and Housing\"\" (2015) recognizes that some countries have started using sex categories in addition to 'male' and 'female'. The option of a third category for sex is provided in the classification variant of sex in the present standard. The Conference of European Statisticians caution that issues related to data collection and residual disclosure should be considered when using a classification with a third category for sex:"]

["It is known that a small proportional error occurs in reporting or coding large response categories (such as 'male' or 'female') but that these can nevertheless be larger than the number of correctly captured responses for a rare category (such as a 'third' sex). Even among the sub-group of particular interest", " response patterns may be particularly sensitive to question wording. It is strongly recommended", " therefore", " that countries should undertake a rigorous testing programme before attempting to collect such information in the census. Furthermore", " it should be noted that including such categories in outputs imposes risk to statistical disclosure since the relevant numbers are likely to be very small", " particularly when cross-classified with other census variables."]

["ISO/IEC 5218:2004 standard ''Information technology - Codes for the representation of human sexes'' specifies a uniform representation of human sexes for the interchange of information. It recognizes two sexes (male and female)", " consistent with the 'Classification of sex at birth' presented in the present standard. Although the ISO/IEC standard provides numeric codes", " it states that these codes do not supplant national standards for codes derived from the names of sexes."]

["Similar to the World Health Organization's \"\"Gender", " equity and human rights", " Glossary of terms and tools\"\"", " this standard refers to sex assigned based on physical characteristics. While the World Health Organization indicates that such characteristics are used to define 'male' and 'female'", " this standard additionally provides a classification variant with three categories ('male'", " 'female' and 'intersex')."]

["This standard also shares similarities with the definitions of sex at birth published by Statistics New Zealand in the \"\"Statistical standard for gender", " sex", " and variations of sex characteristics\"\" (2021) and by the Australian Bureau of Statistics in \"\"Standard for Sex", " Gender", " Variations of Sex Characteristics and Sexual Orientation Variables\"\" (2021)."]

["Statistics New Zealand defines sex at birth as \"\"the sex recorded at a person's birth (for example", " what was recorded on their birth certificate).\"\" The Australian Bureau of Statistics also defines it as sex recorded at birth", " which \"\"refers to what was determined by sex characteristics observed at birth or infancy.\"\" As in the present standard", " they provide variant classifications of sex that include a third category labeled 'another term' in New Zealand and 'another term' and 'non-binary sex' in Australia.\"", "", ""]

Gender includes the following concepts:

- gender identity, which refers to the gender that a person feels internally and individually;

- gender expression, which refers to the way a person presents their gender, regardless of their gender identity, through body language, aesthetic choices or accessories (e.g., clothes, hairstyle and makeup), which may have traditionally been associated with a specific gender.

A person's gender may differ from their sex at birth, and from what is indicated on their current identification or legal documents such as their birth certificate, passport or driver's licence. A person's gender may change over time.

Some people may not identify with a specific gender.

'Person' refers to an individual and is the unit of analysis for most social statistics programs.", "", "", "", ""]

["Gender of person - Usage", "Sex at birth and gender refer to two different concepts but are interrelated. While sex at birth is primarily understood in terms of physical and biological features such as chromosomes, genitals and hormones, gender is a multidimensional concept that is influenced by several additional factors, including cultural and behavioural norms, and self-identity.

Caution should be exercised when comparing counts for the sex at birth of person variable with counts for the gender of person variable. For most people, their sex at birth corresponds to their gender. However, some people's gender may be different from their sex at birth. For example, in a given population the group of persons of female sex does not necessarily correspond to the group of persons of female gender, although the two groups are generally very similar given the relatively small size of the transgender and non-binary populations.

The concept of gender is also different from that of sexual orientation, which is an umbrella term that includes a person's sexual identity, sexual attraction and sexual behaviour.

Conceptions of gender vary between cultures, regions and countries. This concept is strongly affected by ongoing social change and, as a result, is constantly evolving.

The variable 'gender of person' is expected to be used by default in most social statistics programs at Statistics Canada in accordance with the Treasury Board of Canada Secretariat's "Policy Direction to Modernize the Government of Canada's Sex and Gender Information Practices"" (2018)."]

["The variable 'sex at birth of person' can be used where information on sex at birth is needed", " for example", " for measuring some demographic and health indicators. It can be used in conjunction with the variable 'gender of person' to estimate the transgender population. These two variables can also be used", " together with the variable 'sexual orientation of person'", " to estimate the gender and sexual diversity populations", " which are often represented by the LGBTQ2+ acronym (lesbian", " gay", " bisexual", " transgender", " queer", " Two-Spirit or another identity of gender or sexual diversity)."]

["In statistical programs", " gender may be reported in terms of a person's gender identity or expression", " as well as how one is perceived by others", " depending on whether information on gender is based on self-reported data or reported by proxy. Information on sex at birth may also be based on self-reported data or reported by proxy depending on the statistical program."]

["Some people may be reluctant to provide an answer to the question on gender or may give a different answer depending on the context in which it is asked or the order of the questions (for example", " whether the question on sex at birth comes before or after the question on gender). The degree of privacy", " safety and perceived relevance for collecting this information may impact how a person responds."]
["The gender question may be asked for persons of any age", " including children aged 14 and younger", " depending on the survey population.\"", "", "", "", ""]

["Gender of person - Conformity to relevant internationally recognized standards", "This standard shares similarities with the definition of gender published by the Williams Institute at the University of California at Los Angeles School of Law in the \"Best Practices for Asking Questions to Identify Transgender and Other Gender Minority Respondents on Population-Based Surveys\"\" (2014). They define gender as \"\"a multidimensional construct that has psychological", " social", " and behavioral dimensions that include gender identity and gender expression.\"\""]

["The \"\"Yogyakarta Principles on the Application of International Human Rights Law in Relation to Sexual Orientation and Gender Identity\"\" (2017)", " written by the International Commission of Jurists and supported by the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights", " provides a definition of gender identity that includes gender expression:"]

["Gender identity is understood to refer to each person's deeply felt internal and individual experience of gender", " which may or may not correspond with the sex assigned at birth", " including the personal sense of the body (which may involve", " if freely chosen", " modification of bodily appearance or function by medical", " surgical or other means) and other expressions of gender", " including dress", " speech and mannerisms."]

["P003092001", "Creating Sustainable Livelihoods for Colombian Smallholder Cacao Farmers", "SOCODEVI - Canadian Cooperation Society for International Development", "Constant changing implementing conditions coupled with highly complex working environment in Colombia makes it difficult to use traditional funding mechanisms to create sustainable livelihood alternatives to illicit coca production by increasing the incomes of women and men smallholder farmers of cacao.", "Sustainable Scale ", "Results Based Financing (RBF) seeks to maximize results from a cost efficiency perspective, allowing the implementer to swiftly adapt to the conditions in the field, including changing activities as they see fit to best achieve expected results. Co-financing incentivizes greater sense of local ownership, paving the way for/facilitating a gradual transition out of Official Development Assistance (ODA). The COVID-19 pandemic demonstrated that RBF provides greater flexibility to the implementer to adapt to conditions in the field. The exclusive focus on results (rather than activities) incentivizes the implementer to undertake activities that are as cost-effective as possible (value for money). This also allows Global Affairs Canada to spend more time on substantive issues and engage with sector stakeholders to ensure cohesiveness and the sustainability of results. The importance is to ensure strong local ownership and an effective transition into local systems. ", "New", "Successful"]

["P000038001", "Caribbean Disaster Risk Management Program", "Caribbean Disaster Risk Management Program", "Ongoing coastal erosion in Suriname threatens local farmlands and historic pilgrimage sites.", "Proof of Concept ", "The University of Suriname has adopted a sediment trapping approach to coastal protection as an alternative to typical hard solutions of sea walls and berms. ["P001124001", "Inclusive Democratic Development in Burma/Myanmar", "Inter Pares", "Peace is a rare in the regions of Myanmar. The country is often subject to  ethnic disputes and home to millions of people displaced by conflicts. Risks of climate change and forest overexploitation (eg.  illegal logging) are growing. ", "Proof of Concept ", "The Salween Peace Park is a community-driven initiative envisioned to promote holistic environmental protection, sustainable livelihoods, democratic governance, and peace in eastern Karen State. The park, spanning over 5,485 km� is managed through a tripartite management mechanism including customary land management committees, civil society, and the local EGB (the KNU). The Salween Peace Park (SPP) is a good example of rights-based approach and the established of a democratic structure in local communities in order to manage a collective resource. It is unique in integrating inclusive governance, human rights, gender equality, and environmental protection. An inclusive and democratic process has been the foundation of this mechanism since the work began in 2016, involving a long series of community consultations, workshops, and meetings, leading to the creation of the SPP management charter. A public referendum on the park and its management structure was held in 2018, encompassing all villages in the area. In early 2019, village elections were held to elect representatives to the SPP General Assembly and the Governing Committee. The charter ensured women�s representation in these governance structures, including a minimum quota from each of the three entities. While customary law and practices are the foundation of the peace park, and the 40-page Salween Peace Park charter devolves considerable powers to the constituent areas that make up the park, it also outlines the rights-based approach and accountable governance by which the area is managed collectively. The charter includes a section on mechanisms for disputes within the scope of the peace park rules, but issues that cannot be resolved within affected communities, the SPP governing committee, or general assembly will be adjudicated within the KNU judiciary system. In 2020, the Salween Peace Park gained global recognition when it was awarded both the Goldman Environmental Prize and the Equator Prize. As for the impact on the local communities, Inter Pares highlights that the Salween Peace Park is premised on being governed and managed inclusively and democratically. Traditionally, land governance and associated rules and regulations was communicated orally. The Peace Park formally documents and institutionalizes the Karen peoples� ownership of the land. The Karen are directly involved in its creation through extensive community consultation and the park�s charter was created through public referendum involving all villages in the region. Further, village elections are held to vote in representatives to a SPP General Assembly and Governing Committee. The charter ensures that there is female representation in these governing structures. It should also be noted that the Park presents economic opportunity for the Karen community, according to this page of its recipient page of the Equator Prize, �Organic agriculture has allowed villagers to recover livelihoods in an area impoverished from decades of conflict.� It goes without mentioning that the Salween Peace Park is culturally significant to the Karen community, as they are considered the indigenous to the region. It is an example of enhanced participation of marginalized and conflict-impacted communities in local development.", "New", "Successful"]

["P006963001", "Making Waves: Radio-based education for girls in DRC", "War Child Canada", "The project builds on a four-year pilot project that uses interactive radio instruction (IRI) to reach learners that are unable to participate in the formal school system. Radio education has already proven to generate high levels of acceptance within communities, given that radio is a readily available and reliable in the Democratic Republic of Congo, more so than new technology that relies on power and internet connectivity. The radios provided are solar powered to ensure they are available independently of access to electricity. The four-year evidence-based pilot phase for the interactive radio instruction (IRI) demonstrated positive results for children. The recent comparative research conducted by School-to-School International (STS) as part of the current project, in December 2020, also demonstrated the positive impact of the Interactive Radio Instruction on learning.��", "Improved", "Successful"]

", "Transition to Scale", "Burkina Faso received technical assistance from Open Data for Development (OD4D) to implement open data initiatives.
